annotations.text: AURORA — warm firelight against a cold sky. Midnight ground, slow aurora behind everything, one glass material in three depths. The mono type, hairline boxes and lowercase labels of the old build are gone.
Mobile drops blur one step (20px, not 28) and answers touch with a press-scale instead of a hover lift. Chrome floats: nav pill on top, tab bar at the bottom.
The rules the five screens are built from — palette, the three glass depths, edge anatomy, the type ramp and the two motion speeds. Change the accent swatch here and every artboard follows.
